title: Virtual Identity for Artists
audience: Mixed studio / fine arts (photo, sculpture, painting, video)
description: A guest lecture and live build on shaping an artist's online presence: website vs. social platforms, planning a site, preparing files for the web, and building a portfolio with Cargo.
summary: Your virtual identity is often the first studio visit — the way curators, jurors, and collaborators meet your work before they meet you. This talk for Concordia's *Survival Tactics* frames the artist's online presence as an ecosystem: a website you own (your studio) and the social platforms and listings you rent (the group show), all pointing back to a home base.

The session pairs concepts with practical craft — deciding what's public, private, or mixed; planning a site with a sitemap; documenting work and preparing images and video for the web; and a live demo building a portfolio site with Cargo. Aimed at a mixed studio / fine-arts audience across photography, sculpture, painting, and video.
